description: Prompts for the explore turn-count A/B harness. Each case is a real exploration ask; the harness runs each under different MINI_CODE_SUBAGENT_EXPLORE_MAX_TURNS values and compares success/partial/fallback rates and cost. Run scripts/run_explore_turn_ab.py --live to spend API quota; --scripted validates the pipeline only.

cases.prompt: Map the billing module: which files exist, what does each own, and how do they interact? Return the file list with one-line responsibilities.
Trace how an invoice gets created end to end: from the HTTP entry point through the service layer to persistence. Name every function in the chain.
Find every place application configuration is read or written, and which one is authoritative for the database URL.
Enumerate all custom exception classes and every place they are raised. The complete list, not a sample.
Inventory the test suite: which modules have tests, which have none, and where are the integration tests configured?
Which third-party packages does the web layer depend on directly, and which files import them? List per-package importers.
List every entry point (CLI commands, scripts, HTTP routes) with the file and function that implements it.
Find all uses of threads, locks, and async primitives. For each, note what shared state it protects.
Compare the persisted record shapes written by the storage layer against the dataclasses that represent them; list every field mismatch.
Identify functions defined in the project that no test, script, or module references. Very thorough: check alternate naming conventions before concluding.
